summary: iter113 Profitability Calculator — backend + frontend testing complete. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter113_profitability.py with 13 pytest cases covering settings CRUD, operation compute correctness (net_gain=107.3, profitability_pct≈7.5035 for the anchor case, loss branch works), list totals + filters, delete + 404, permission gating (admin OK, employee default [] OK, employee scoped ['orders'] → 403, VIP → 403), permission catalog includes 'profitability' with label 'Cálculo de Rentabilidad', and Company Funds regression. ALL 13 PASSED. Frontend: logged in as admin via cookie, /admin/company-funds?tab=profitability renders admin-profitability page with hub tab visible. Calculator with 715/740/26/37/1 shows Net gain 53,65 (green), Margin 7,5%, Max buy 793,65. Projections table, pairs summary table, ops table, ops totals, filter buttons all present. Settings dialog opens, per-currency CUP inputs work, save triggers 'Percentages saved' toast. Log-operation dialog contains all required data-testids (client/currency/payment/qty/sell/buy/preview-net/submit).
